5-kyuu kara 1-kyuu Kanzen Taiou Saishin.name: 5-kyuu kara 1-kyuu Kanzen Taiou Saishin Kako Mondai: Nijishiken Taisaku - Eiken Kanzenban
5-kyuu kara 1-kyuu Kanzen Taiou Saishin.summary: An edutainment game for the Nintendo DS.

Brain Age - Train Your Brain in Minutes.name: Brain Age: Train Your Brain in Minutes a Day!
Brain Age - Train Your Brain in Minutes.summary: Brain Age keeps the brain active through a series of mathematical questions, Stroop tests and Sudoku.

Casual Mania.name: Casual Mania!
Casual Mania.summary: Feed your addiction with Casual Mania - four of the world's most popular games now available to play on your Nintendo DS. Play Hidden Objects and search for items at an excavation site under the Louvre. In the game 3 in a Row, you need to collect three or more of the same gems. Marble Popper challenges you to put together combinations of at least three colored balls. Or run a french beauty salon in the hectic time management game of Beauty Resort.

Fritz Chess.name: Fritz Chess
Fritz Chess.summary: A chess game available from a variety of downloadable platforms.

Hakuouki - Zuisouroku DS.name: Hakuoki Zuisouroku DS
Hakuouki - Zuisouroku DS.summary:
Port of Hakuoki Zuisouroku for the Nintendo DS.

Zuisouroku fills in the gaps in the Hakuouki story. You can see the everyday lives of Chizuru and the Shinsengumi members. Discover secrets that the men didn't tell you in the original game and unlock scenarios that are only mentioned briefly in the main story.

Monster High - Ghoul Spirit.name: Monster High: Ghoul Spirit
Monster High - Ghoul Spirit.summary: Monster High: Ghoul Spirit is a 2011 party video game developed by ImaginEngine and published by THQ for the Nintendo DS and Wii consoles and got re-released by Little Orbit in 2014. It is loosely based on the Monster High line of dolls by Mattel.

Penguin no Mondai - Saikyou Penguin Dens.name: Penguin no Mondai: Saikyou Penguin Densetsu!
Penguin no Mondai - Saikyou Penguin Dens.summary: Penguin no Mondai: Saikyou Penguin Densetsu! is an Action game, developed by Future Creates and published by Konami, which was released in Japan in 2008.

Ridge Racer DS.name: Ridge Racer DS
Ridge Racer DS.summary: The Ridge Racer series returns with an all-new racing experience on the DS. The DS version lets you control your vehicle using the handheld's touch screen and race in wireless multiplayer matches for up to six players. You can race on 20 tracks in three different locations, including the Ridge Racer cityscape, a Northwest course from Ridge Racer Revolution, and a desert area in the Southwest. With Ridge Racer DS, you can experience fast-paced racing action in the palm of your hand.

Sims 2, The.name: The Sims 2
Sims 2, The.summary:
The Sims 2 for Nintendo DS is the first DS game of The Sims 2. Like the many of the console games it takes place in Strangetown with some of the same faces.
The aim of the game is to improve the hotel by adding extensions, furnishing rooms, completing goals, rescue guests or help them find missing objects and keeping the hotel clean.
